resolved_conflicts.explanation: The NHLR description and Jackson's Ramblings (which repeats the registry description) give 1935 by the CCC. The NHLR Built field gives 1938. The story reports both and does not pick one. The 1819 News column says the CCC stopped building towers when the United States entered WWII, which fits a 1935 build but does not confirm it.
NHLR gives US 863, AL 41; Jackson's Ramblings gives US 863, AL 42. The story uses the NHLR number and notes the other.

sources.title: Thomas Kaufmann: Keeping Alabama's historic lookout towers

notes_for_editor: Thin record. The NHLR detail page is the main source. Its description says the tower was built in 1935 by the CCC, but its Built field says 1938; the story reports the conflict. Registry number AL 41 (NHLR) vs AL 42 (Jackson's Ramblings) is also unresolved. The Forest Lookouts page has only a header (Washington County, Alabama Forestry Commission). The 1819 News column (Thomas Kaufmann, 12.28.25) is general context about Alabama towers and is not about Jordan; it is cited only for the CCC/New Deal timeline and the general safety remark, which the story flags as not Jordan-specific. Current condition, access and staffing are unknown; status 'standing' rests on the NHLR listing and the existence of a drone video, not on a dated inspection. The brief's coordinates and elevation (81 m, 265 ft) match NHLR; the brief's '1938 built' is the NHLR Built field, so no correction is proposed. No photos added; the NHLR page's drone video is on Jackson's Ramblings and is not a photo. Not verified: whether the public may climb it.
